headline: BTOB's Yook Sungjae injures chin ahead of drama premiere
sub: He'll attend the 'Nine to Six' press conference in a mask
caption:
BTOB's Yook Sungjae has injured his chin just one day before his new drama 'Nine to Six' premieres.

On Nov 24 KST, he shared on social media that he fell at home due to orthostatic hypotension and needed stitches on his chin. He said he will attend the press conference wearing a mask, apologized to reporters and fans, and asked for their understanding. The SBS drama, co-starring Park Min-young, premieres Nov 25 at 9 PM KST.

📌 Source: Yook Sungjae's SNS, via Korean media (Ilgan Sports, Sports Kyunghyang)
